generic.Defined scope/population: All emergency services invoices submitted by the mitigation vendor against this claim assignment.
generic.In-scope period: From vendor invoice receipt to the approval decision being stamped in the claim financials tab.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vendor name, invoice number, line items, equipment days and invoice total present on the invoice record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Invoice line totals equal the header total and sit at or below the authorized mitigation scope amount.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved invoice, drying logs and approval stamp held in the claim file with approver ID and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every short-paid or disputed line recorded with its reason and the vendor response on the claim.
generic.Test population: Emergency services invoices approved on the claim during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any approved line exceeds the authorized emergency mitigation scope amount.
generic.Exception handling path: Invoices above the adjuster authority limit route to the claims manager before approval is recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Invoice status reads Approved for Payment with approver ID, date and amount recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Claim financials tab in the claims management platform plus the claim file document repository.

steps.title: Open the emergency services invoice in the claims platform financials tab
sop: Open the claim in the claims management platform and go to the financials or invoices tab.
Locate the emergency services invoice and open the vendor invoice record.
Done when the invoice record is open and linked to the mitigation assignment.
verify: Confirm the invoice is attached to the correct claim number and assignment ID.
Pass when the open invoice shows the claim number and the mitigation assignment reference.

steps.title: Match the invoicing vendor to the vendor on the mitigation assignment
sop: Compare the invoicing vendor name and ID to the vendor recorded on the mitigation assignment.
Query any mismatch or unnotified subcontractor billing before going further.
Done when the invoicing vendor is confirmed as the assigned mitigation vendor.
verify: Check the vendor ID on the invoice equals the vendor ID on the assignment record.
Pass when both vendor IDs match with no unexplained subcontractor.

steps.title: Check invoiced line items against the authorized scope in the claims platform
sop: List water extraction, drying equipment days and board-up square footage from the invoice.
Compare each line to the authorized emergency scope amount held on the assignment.
Done when every invoice line is marked in scope or flagged as unauthorized.
verify: Recompute the invoice total and compare it to the authorized scope cap.
Pass when no line and no total exceeds the authorized emergency scope amount.

steps.title: Reconcile billed equipment days to the daily moisture logs in the claim file
sop: Open the daily moisture and drying logs held in the claim file repository.
Count logged dehumidifier and air mover days against the billed equipment days.
Done when billed equipment days are matched to logged days or the excess is flagged.
verify: Check that billed days never exceed logged days for any equipment type.
Pass when billed and logged equipment days agree or a written variance is recorded.

steps.title: Confirm the invoice total sits within adjuster authority and route if not
sop: Compare the payable invoice total to the adjuster authority limit for emergency spend.
Route the invoice to the claims manager where the total exceeds that limit.
Done when the correct approval level is established for the invoice.
verify: Check the approval routing against the authority tier recorded for the approver.
Pass when no invoice above the authority limit is approved by the adjuster alone.

steps.title: Record the approval and log exceptions on the claim
sop: Click Approve so the status flips to Approved for Payment with the approver ID stamped.
Record each short-paid or disputed line with its reason and the vendor response.
Done when the approval and all exception notes are saved to the claim.
verify: Reopen the invoice and confirm status, approver ID, date and amount are recorded.
Pass when the invoice reads Approved for Payment with every exception noted.

generic.Defined scope/population: The loss site inspected on this claim and every area showing water, wind or fire exposure.
generic.In-scope period: From the first site visit to the mitigation-needed flag being set on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss cause, water category and class, affected room count and moisture readings recorded on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Affected room count in the note equals the number of rooms with recorded moisture readings and photos.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Site photos and the mitigation assessment note stored on the claim with capture date and time.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Areas where mitigation was considered but ruled out recorded with the reason on the claim.
generic.Test population: Emergency mitigation assessments completed after a site visit in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the assessment note is recorded more than 24 hours after the site visit.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsafe or inaccessible areas are noted as unassessed and rebooked with the claims adjuster.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mitigation-needed flag set Yes or No with a rationale note listing each service required.
generic.Evidence location: Claim file document repository for photos and the claim notes in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Record loss cause and water category or class on the claim
sop: Open the loss description in the claims management platform.
Record the loss cause and the water category one to three or the wind or fire exposure.
Done when the loss cause and category are saved on the claim.
verify: Check the recorded category matches the contamination source observed on site.
Pass when loss cause and water category or class are present on the claim record.

steps.title: Confirm whether the property is unsecured or actively taking on water
sop: Walk the roof line, glazing and openings and check for standing water or active ingress.
Record whether the building envelope is currently open or compromised.
Done when the secured or unsecured status is documented on the claim.
verify: Check the status note names the specific opening or ingress point observed.
Pass when the claim states the property is secured or names the open exposure.

steps.title: List the emergency services required for the loss
sop: Decide which services apply from extraction, dry-out, board-up, tarping and temporary fencing.
List each required service separately on the assessment note rather than as a general request.
Done when every required emergency service is listed individually.
verify: Check each listed service ties to an observed condition in the note.
Pass when every listed service has a stated justification.

steps.title: Record moisture meter readings and affected room count
sop: Take moisture meter readings on affected drywall, subfloor and framing in each room.
Record the reading per room and total the affected room count on the claim.
Done when readings and room count are recorded for every affected area.
verify: Count rooms with readings and compare to the affected room count entered.
Pass when the room count equals the number of rooms with recorded readings.

steps.title: Attach supporting site photos to the claim file
sop: Collect the initial site photos taken before any equipment was placed.
Upload them to the claim file repository and index them against the assessment note.
Done when the supporting photo set is attached and indexed to the claim.
verify: Open the claim file and confirm photos exist for each affected room listed.
Pass when the photo set covers every room named in the assessment.

steps.title: Set the mitigation-needed flag with a documented rationale
sop: Set the mitigation-needed flag to Yes or No on the claim record.
Write the rationale note citing the readings, services required and site condition.
Done when the flag and rationale note are saved within 24 hours of the visit.
verify: Compare the note timestamp to the recorded site visit date and time.
Pass when the flag is set with rationale within 24 hours of the site visit.

generic.Defined scope/population: Emergency service authorizations issued on this claim to prevent further damage.
generic.In-scope period: From the mitigation need being confirmed to the authorization number being issued to the vendor.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authorized dollar cap, authorizing user ID, coverage-confirmed flag and vendor assignment reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Authorized cap on the assignment equals the amount stated in the authorization issued to the vendor.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authorization record retained on the claim with issue date, cap and authorizing user ID.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests above the adjuster authority tier logged with the escalation and manager decision.
generic.Test population: Emergency service authorizations issued on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any authorization is issued without a coverage-confirmed flag or without a dollar cap.
generic.Exception handling path: Amounts above the adjuster tier escalate to the claims manager before any authorization is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Authorization exists with a capped dollar amount, authorizing user ID and vendor assignment link.
generic.Evidence location: Vendor assignment and authorization records in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Confirm policy in force and peril covered in the claims platform
sop: Open the coverage tab and check the policy term covers the date of loss.
Confirm the reported peril is a covered cause under the policy in force.
Done when the coverage-confirmed flag is set on the claim.
verify: Check the policy effective and expiry dates bracket the date of loss.
Pass when coverage is confirmed on the claim before any spend is authorized.

steps.title: Set the authorized dollar cap on the emergency assignment
sop: Size the cap from the services listed in the mitigation assessment.
Enter the authorized dollar cap on the assignment rather than leaving it open-ended.
Done when a specific dollar cap is saved on the assignment.
verify: Reopen the assignment and check the authorized amount field is populated.
Pass when the assignment holds a numeric cap and no open-ended authorization.

steps.title: State the over-cap condition in the authorization text
sop: Write into the authorization that work beyond the cap needs prior written approval.
Name the contact and route the vendor must use to request an increase.
Done when the over-cap condition is included in the issued authorization.
verify: Read the issued authorization text and confirm the condition is present.
Pass when the authorization states that over-cap work requires prior written approval.

steps.title: Escalate requests above the adjuster authority tier
sop: Compare the requested amount to the adjuster authority tier for emergency spend.
Refer amounts above the tier to the claims manager for a documented decision.
Done when the approval decision at the correct tier is recorded on the claim.
verify: Check the approving user against the authority tier for the amount authorized.
Pass when no authorization exceeds the authorizing user authority limit.

steps.title: Issue the authorization number to the mitigation vendor
sop: Generate the authorization number in the claims management platform.
Send it to the vendor with the capped amount and scope of authorized services.
Done when the vendor holds the authorization number and cap.
verify: Confirm the sent authorization carries the number and the cap figure.
Pass when the vendor authorization shows a number and a capped amount.

steps.title: Log the authorization against the vendor assignment record
sop: Attach the issued authorization to the vendor assignment record on the claim.
Record the authorizing user ID and issue date against the assignment.
Done when the authorization is linked to the assignment with user ID and date.
verify: Open the assignment and confirm the linked authorization, cap and user ID.
Pass when the assignment shows the authorization with cap and authorizing user ID.

generic.Defined scope/population: Temporary protective repairs authorized on this claim such as tarping, shrink wrap and board-up.
generic.In-scope period: From the protective need being identified to the temporary repair authorization being issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authorized repair list, capped amount, expected duration and insured acknowledgement on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Authorized temporary repair amount equals the sum of the individual protective items listed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pre-work photos of each affected elevation stored in the claim file with capture date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Protective items requested but not authorized recorded with the reason on the claim.
generic.Test population: Temporary repair authorizations issued on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an authorization lacks a capped amount, a duration or pre-installation photos.
generic.Exception handling path: Requests exceeding adjuster authority route to the claims manager before authorization is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Authorization records the scope, capped amount and expected duration of the temporary repair.
generic.Evidence location: Vendor assignment in the claims management platform and photos in the claim file repository.

steps.title: List the specific temporary repairs being authorized
sop: Identify the protective work needed such as roof tarp, shrink wrap, plywood closure or temporary power.
Enter each item separately on the authorization rather than as general temporary repairs.
Done when every authorized protective item is listed individually.
verify: Check each listed item ties to an opening or exposure noted at inspection.
Pass when every authorized item has a matching documented exposure.

steps.title: Note the credit of temporary repair cost against the final estimate
sop: Confirm the temporary repair cost will be credited against the final repair estimate.
Record that credit position on the claim file so the final settlement reflects it.
Done when the credit note is saved on the claim.
verify: Read the claim note and confirm the credit treatment is stated.
Pass when the claim records that temporary repair cost credits the final estimate.

steps.title: Capture pre-work photos of the affected elevation or opening
sop: Photograph each elevation or opening before the temporary repair is installed.
Upload the photos to the claim file repository and index them as pre-installation.
Done when pre-work photos exist for every authorized protective item.
verify: Match each authorized item to a pre-installation photo in the claim file.
Pass when no authorized item is missing its pre-work photo.

steps.title: Set the authorized amount and expected duration on the assignment
sop: Enter the capped dollar amount for the temporary repair on the vendor assignment.
Enter the expected duration the temporary repair is meant to remain in place.
Done when both the cap and the duration are saved on the assignment.
verify: Reopen the assignment and check both the amount and duration fields.
Pass when the assignment holds a capped amount and an expected duration.

steps.title: Record the insured acknowledgement that repairs are protective only
sop: Explain to the insured that the work is protective and not a permanent repair.
Record the acknowledgement with date and channel on the claim notes.
Done when the insured acknowledgement is captured on the claim.
verify: Check the note names the insured, the date and the channel used.
Pass when the claim records the insured acknowledgement with date and channel.

steps.title: Issue the temporary repair authorization to the vendor
sop: Issue the authorization with the itemised scope, cap and duration to the vendor.
File the issued authorization against the vendor assignment record.
Done when the vendor holds the authorization and it is filed on the claim.
verify: Open the assignment and confirm the issued authorization is attached.
Pass when the filed authorization matches the scope, cap and duration recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every affected room and elevation on the loss site plus damaged contents needing valuation.
generic.In-scope period: From arrival on site to before any drying equipment or protective work is placed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Room labels, moisture readings per material, photo captions and content serial or model detail.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of rooms photographed equals the affected room count recorded in the mitigation assessment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Photo set and moisture log uploaded to the claim file and indexed as Pre-Mitigation with capture dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rooms not documented due to access or safety recorded with the reason and a rebooking action.
generic.Test population: Pre-mitigation documentation sets captured on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any billed room lacks a pre-mitigation photo or an initial moisture reading.
generic.Exception handling path: Inaccessible rooms are logged as undocumented and revisited before mitigation invoices are approved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pre-mitigation photo set and initial moisture readings uploaded and indexed to the claim.
generic.Evidence location: Claim file document repository indexed as Pre-Mitigation and linked from the claims platform.

steps.title: Photograph each affected room and elevation before equipment is set
sop: Take a wide shot and close-up shots of each affected room and elevation.
Capture the images before any drying equipment or protective work is placed.
Done when every affected room and elevation has wide and close-up photos.
verify: Count photographed rooms against the affected room list on the claim.
Pass when every affected room has both a wide and a close-up image.

steps.title: Record initial moisture readings per affected material
sop: Take moisture meter readings on drywall, subfloor and framing in each affected room.
Record each reading against its room label and material type.
Done when readings exist for every affected material in every room.
verify: Check each reading carries a room label and a material type.
Pass when no recorded reading is missing its room or material label.

steps.title: Photograph pre-existing damage and wear separately
sop: Identify wear, deterioration or damage that predates this loss.
Photograph and caption each item so it is not later attributed to the loss.
Done when all observed pre-existing damage is photographed and captioned.
verify: Read the captions and confirm each names the pre-existing condition.
Pass when every pre-existing damage photo carries an explanatory caption.

steps.title: Capture serial and model detail for damaged contents
sop: Photograph data plates or labels on damaged contents and equipment.
Record serial and model numbers where valuation will be needed later.
Done when every valuation-relevant item has serial or model detail captured.
verify: Check the contents list against the captured serial and model records.
Pass when each valuation-relevant item has legible serial or model detail.

steps.title: Upload the photo set and moisture log to the claim file repository
sop: Upload the complete photo set and the moisture log to the claim file repository.
Confirm no images remain only in local storage or email attachments.
Done when all pre-loss media is held in the claim file repository.
verify: Search the claim file for the full set and compare counts to the captured set.
Pass when the repository holds every captured photo and the moisture log.

steps.title: Index the uploaded documentation as Pre-Mitigation
sop: Apply the Pre-Mitigation document type to the uploaded photo set and moisture log.
Link the indexed documents to the claim in the claims management platform.
Done when the documentation is indexed as Pre-Mitigation and visible on the claim.
verify: Filter the claim documents on the Pre-Mitigation index and check completeness.
Pass when the Pre-Mitigation filter returns the full photo set and moisture log.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every line item in the emergency services scope submitted for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the emergency scope to the revised authorized scope being saved on the assignment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each scope line carries a description, quantity, unit rate and a pre-loss condition reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Revised authorized scope total equals the original total less every removed or reclassified line.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scope review note and pre-loss condition photos retained on the claim with review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each excluded or reclassified betterment line recorded with its rationale on the review note.
generic.Test population: Emergency scope line items reviewed for betterment on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any betterment line remains inside the approved emergency scope.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed betterment calls refer to the claims adjuster for a coverage position before the scope is fixed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Betterment review note lists every excluded or reclassified line with a stated rationale.
generic.Evidence location: Scope review note and revised assignment in the claims management platform plus claim file photos.

steps.title: Compare emergency scope lines to the pre-loss condition photos
sop: Open the emergency scope and the Pre-Mitigation photo set side by side.
Compare each scope line to the material and finish visible before the loss.
Done when every scope line is matched to its pre-loss condition evidence.
verify: Check each scope line references a specific pre-loss photo or note.
Pass when no scope line is unmatched to pre-loss condition evidence.

steps.title: Flag lines replacing undamaged material or upgrading grade
sop: Identify lines replacing material that was undamaged at the pre-loss inspection.
Flag lines upgrading grade or finish beyond the pre-loss condition.
Done when every upgrade or undamaged-material line is flagged.
verify: Review the flagged list against the photo evidence for each line.
Pass when every flagged line has photographic support for the flag.

steps.title: Confirm code-upgrade lines only where ordinance or law applies
sop: Check the policy for ordinance or law coverage and its limit.
Confirm each code-upgrade line falls inside that coverage grant.
Done when code-upgrade lines are confirmed covered or removed.
verify: Match each retained code-upgrade line to the ordinance or law provision.
Pass when no code-upgrade line is retained without ordinance or law coverage.

steps.title: Remove or reclassify betterment lines with a recorded reason
sop: Remove betterment lines or reclassify them as insured-funded upgrades.
Record the reason for each removal or reclassification on the review note.
Done when every betterment line has a disposition and a reason.
verify: Read the review note and confirm a reason exists for each line.
Pass when every excluded or reclassified line carries a written rationale.

steps.title: Recalculate and update the authorized scope total on the assignment
sop: Recalculate the scope total after removals and reclassifications.
Update the authorized scope amount on the vendor assignment record.
Done when the assignment shows the revised authorized total.
verify: Compare the revised assignment total to the recalculated scope figure.
Pass when the assignment total equals the recalculated scope total.

steps.title: File the betterment review note on the claim
sop: Finalise the review note listing every excluded or reclassified line.
File the note on the claim and notify the adjuster of the revised scope.
Done when the review note is filed and the adjuster is notified.
verify: Open the claim and confirm the review note is present and dated.
Pass when the filed note lists each excluded line with rationale.

generic.Defined scope/population: Site access arrangements between the insured and the emergency mitigation contractor for this loss.
generic.In-scope period: From the mitigation dispatch to the agreed access window being confirmed to the contractor.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Access date, time window, entry method, on-site contact name and alternate number on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The access window sent to the contractor matches the window agreed with the insured on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Call note and the access confirmation sent to the contractor logged on the claim with timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed contact attempts and access constraints logged with the follow-up action taken.
generic.Test population: Emergency mitigation site access arrangements made on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the claim lacks an agreed access window or a follow-up diary for the access date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreachable insureds escalate to the field claims adjuster for direct contact the same day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Agreed site access window and on-site contact recorded with a diary set for the access date.
generic.Evidence location: Claim notes and diary in the claims management platform plus the email or Teams confirmation.

steps.title: Call the insured to agree the access date, window and entry method
sop: Call the insured on the number held on the claim record.
Agree the access date, time window and entry method such as on-site, lockbox or key release.
Done when the access date, window and entry method are agreed.
verify: Read back the agreed details to the insured before ending the call.
Pass when the claim note records the agreed date, window and entry method.

steps.title: Confirm who will be present and capture an alternate contact
sop: Confirm the name of the person who will be on site during the access window.
Capture an alternate contact number for the access date.
Done when the on-site contact and alternate number are recorded.
verify: Check both contact fields are populated on the claim record.
Pass when an on-site contact name and an alternate number are present.

steps.title: Note access constraints on the claim
sop: Ask about gated access, pets, tenant occupancy and utility shut-off.
Record each constraint on the claim so the crew arrives prepared.
Done when all reported access constraints are recorded.
verify: Read the constraints note and confirm each is specific and actionable.
Pass when every reported constraint is recorded on the claim.

steps.title: Send the confirmed access window to the mitigation contractor
sop: Send the agreed window, entry method and constraints to the contractor by email or Teams.
Include the on-site contact name and alternate number in the message.
Done when the contractor holds the confirmed access details.
verify: Compare the sent details to the window agreed with the insured.
Pass when the sent window matches the agreed window exactly.

steps.title: Log the contractor notification on the claim
sop: Record the send date, time and recipient on the claim log.
Attach or reference the sent message against the mitigation assignment.
Done when the notification is logged against the assignment.
verify: Open the claim log and confirm the send entry exists with a timestamp.
Pass when the claim log shows the contractor notification with date and time.

steps.title: Set a diary for the access date to catch a no-show
sop: Create a diary or task in the claims platform dated on the access date.
Set the task to confirm attendance and escalate a no-show the same day.
Done when the diary entry exists for the scheduled access date.
verify: Check the diary date equals the agreed access date.
Pass when an open diary entry exists on the access date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Emergency water extraction and board-up dispatches raised for this loss location.
generic.In-scope period: From the mitigation need being confirmed to vendor acknowledgement and ETA being recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss address, peril, access window, insured contact and authorization cap on the dispatch package.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One acknowledged dispatch exists per open mitigation need with no duplicate crews assigned.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dispatch message and acknowledgement retained on the assignment with dispatch and reply timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-acknowledged dispatches logged with the escalation and the alternate vendor used.
generic.Test population: Emergency mitigation dispatches raised on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a dispatch remains in Sent status past the emergency response SLA without escalation.
generic.Exception handling path: No acknowledgement inside the SLA window triggers dispatch to the next qualified vendor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment shows the dispatch timestamp plus vendor acknowledgement and crew ETA.
generic.Evidence location: Mitigation assignment record in the claims management platform plus the email or Teams thread.

steps.title: Select a mitigation vendor covering the loss ZIP with capacity
sop: Filter the network directory for emergency mitigation vendors serving the loss ZIP code.
Check current capacity and open assignment counts before selecting.
Done when a vendor with coverage and capacity is selected.
verify: Confirm the selected vendor service area includes the loss ZIP code.
Pass when the vendor is active, in area and has capacity recorded.

steps.title: Build the dispatch package in the claims platform
sop: Assemble the loss address, peril, access window and insured contact.
Add the authorization cap so the crew works to a known limit.
Done when the dispatch package holds all five elements.
verify: Read the package and check each required element is present.
Pass when address, peril, access window, contact and cap are all present.

steps.title: Send the dispatch and capture the dispatch timestamp
sop: Send the dispatch through the claims management platform to the selected vendor.
Confirm the system records the dispatch timestamp on the assignment.
Done when the dispatch is sent and timestamped on the assignment.
verify: Open the assignment and check the dispatch timestamp is populated.
Pass when the assignment shows a system dispatch timestamp.

steps.title: Confirm crew ETA against the emergency response SLA
sop: Obtain the crew ETA from the vendor by phone, email or Teams.
Compare the ETA to the emergency response SLA for the loss type.
Done when the ETA is recorded and compared to the SLA.
verify: Check the recorded ETA against the SLA target on the assignment.
Pass when the ETA meets the SLA or a breach note is recorded.

steps.title: Escalate to an alternate vendor when acknowledgement is late
sop: Monitor the assignment for acknowledgement inside the SLA window.
Dispatch the next qualified vendor where no acknowledgement is received.
Done when either acknowledgement is recorded or an alternate is dispatched.
verify: Check no assignment sits in Sent status past the SLA without an escalation note.
Pass when every late dispatch shows an escalation or a replacement dispatch.

steps.title: Record acknowledgement and ETA on the mitigation assignment
sop: Record the vendor acknowledgement, contact name and ETA on the assignment.
Move the assignment status to Accepted so the response clock advances.
Done when acknowledgement and ETA are saved and the status is updated.
verify: Reopen the assignment and confirm status, acknowledgement and ETA fields.
Pass when the assignment shows acknowledgement and ETA with the correct status.

generic.Defined scope/population: Pre-mitigation and post-mitigation documentation sets for every room billed by the mitigation vendor.
generic.In-scope period: From vendor mobilisation to the post-mitigation set and final moisture readings being received.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Room labels, capture dates, equipment counts and final moisture readings present in both sets.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rooms in the photo sets equal the rooms billed on the mitigation invoice.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Both photo sets and drying logs indexed to the claim as Pre-Mitigation and Post-Mitigation with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected or incomplete vendor submissions logged with the re-request date and the response.
generic.Test population: Mitigation documentation sets received from the vendor on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any mitigation invoice is approved while post-mitigation documentation is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: Sets missing labels, dates or dry-standard readings are rejected and re-requested from the vendor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Both photo sets plus drying logs present on the claim covering every billed room.
generic.Evidence location: Claim file document repository indexed by mitigation stage and linked on the claims platform.

steps.title: Obtain the vendor pre-mitigation photo set
sop: Request the pre-mitigation photo set from the mitigation vendor.
Check the set covers every room that will be billed.
Done when the pre-mitigation set is received and room coverage is confirmed.
verify: Compare rooms in the photo set to the rooms on the authorized scope.
Pass when every billed room appears in the pre-mitigation set.

steps.title: Obtain the post-mitigation photo set and final moisture readings
sop: Request the post-mitigation photo set and the final moisture readings.
Check the readings evidence that the dry standard was achieved.
Done when the post-mitigation set and final readings are received.
verify: Read the final readings against the stated dry standard for each material.
Pass when final readings meet the dry standard in every documented room.

steps.title: Check the daily drying logs against the invoice period
sop: Open the daily drying logs and read the equipment counts and dates.
Compare the log dates to the period covered by the vendor invoice.
Done when log dates and equipment counts are reconciled to the invoice period.
verify: Check every invoiced day has a corresponding drying log entry.
Pass when logged days and equipment counts cover the invoiced period.

steps.title: Reject and re-request incomplete documentation sets
sop: Identify sets missing room labels, capture dates or dry-standard readings.
Reject them and re-request the missing elements from the vendor.
Done when every deficient set is rejected with a dated re-request.
verify: Check each rejection carries a stated deficiency and a re-request date.
Pass when every rejected set has a logged deficiency and re-request.

steps.title: Index both sets to the claim file repository
sop: Upload both photo sets and the drying logs to the claim file repository.
Index them as Pre-Mitigation and Post-Mitigation against the claim.
Done when both sets are indexed under the correct document types.
verify: Filter claim documents by each index and confirm both sets return.
Pass when both Pre-Mitigation and Post-Mitigation filters return complete sets.

steps.title: Block invoice approval until documentation is complete
sop: Set the documentation-complete flag only once both sets and logs are on file.
Notify the approver that the invoice cannot be approved until the flag is set.
Done when the documentation status is recorded against the invoice.
verify: Check no mitigation invoice is approved while the flag is unset.
Pass when every approved mitigation invoice has complete documentation on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every line on the emergency mitigation vendor invoice for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From invoice receipt to the reconciliation worksheet and dispute outcomes being filed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line description, quantity, unit rate, equipment type and service date present on each invoice line.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recalculated invoice total equals the vendor total and stays within the authorization cap.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation worksheet saved with the drying logs and rate card version used for the check.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each unsupported line raised as a short-pay or dispute with the vendor response recorded.
generic.Test population: Emergency mitigation vendor invoices reconciled on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any invoice is paid above the authorization cap without a documented approved variance.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported lines are short-paid or disputed in writing before payment is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciliation note or worksheet attached showing invoice versus authorized scope variance.
generic.Evidence location: Claim financials in the claims management platform plus the Excel reconciliation worksheet.

steps.title: Line-match the vendor invoice to the authorized scope
sop: Export the invoice lines and the authorized scope lines into the reconciliation worksheet.
Match each invoice line to an authorized scope line and mark unmatched lines.
Done when every invoice line is matched or flagged as unauthorized.
verify: Count flagged lines and confirm each has a reason recorded.
Pass when no invoice line is left unmatched and unexplained.

steps.title: Check equipment charges against the drying log days
sop: Read dehumidifier and air mover days from the daily drying logs.
Compare logged days to the equipment days billed on the invoice.
Done when every billed equipment day is matched to a logged day.
verify: Compute the difference between billed and logged equipment days.
Pass when billed days do not exceed logged days for any equipment type.

steps.title: Verify labour hours and premiums against the contracted rate card
sop: Open the contracted rate card version applying at the service date.
Check labour hours, after-hours and emergency premiums against those rates.
Done when every labour and premium line is checked against the rate card.
verify: Recalculate each labour line at the contracted rate.
Pass when no labour or premium rate exceeds the contracted rate card.

steps.title: Recalculate the invoice total against the authorization cap
sop: Recalculate the invoice total from the verified line quantities and rates.
Compare the recalculated total to the authorization cap on the assignment.
Done when the recalculated total and the cap comparison are recorded.
verify: Check the recalculated total against the vendor stated total and the cap.
Pass when the payable total is within the authorization cap.

steps.title: Raise a written short-pay or dispute for unsupported lines
sop: Draft the short-pay or dispute listing each unsupported line and the reason.
Send it to the vendor and record the send date on the claim.
Done when every unsupported line is disputed in writing.
verify: Check each unsupported line appears on the dispute correspondence.
Pass when no unsupported line is paid without a written dispute.

steps.title: Attach the reconciliation worksheet and vendor response to the claim
sop: Save the completed reconciliation worksheet against the claim financials.
Record the vendor response to each disputed line on the claim.
Done when the worksheet and vendor responses are filed on the claim.
verify: Open the claim and confirm the worksheet and responses are attached.
Pass when the claim holds the worksheet showing variance and vendor responses.

generic.Defined scope/population: Indemnity and expense reserves on this claim affected by emergency mitigation and the revised estimate.
generic.In-scope period: From the mitigation cost being known to the reserve transaction being posted on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Mitigation incurred, expected mitigation cost, revised repair estimate and reserve bucket on the transaction.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Posted reserve equals mitigation cost plus revised repair estimate less amounts already paid.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reserve transaction note citing the estimate version and invoice figures retained on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reserve movements above threshold logged with the manager approval and decision date.
generic.Test population: Reserve changes posted for mitigation cost on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any reserve change above the approval threshold is posted without recorded approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Movements above the threshold route to the claims manager before the transaction is posted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reserve transaction posted with a rationale note referencing mitigation cost and repair estimate.
generic.Evidence location: Reserve transaction history and notes in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Total incurred and expected emergency mitigation cost
sop: Sum the mitigation invoices already approved on the claim.
Add the expected remaining cost from the authorized scope.
Done when the total mitigation cost figure is calculated.
verify: Cross-check the total against the authorization cap and approved invoices.
Pass when the mitigation total ties to the approved invoices and cap.

steps.title: Add the revised repair estimate to derive the indemnity reserve
sop: Open the current approved repair estimate version on the claim.
Add the estimate figure to the mitigation total to derive the indemnity reserve.
Done when the new indemnity reserve figure is calculated.
verify: Recompute the sum from the estimate and mitigation figures.
Pass when the derived reserve equals mitigation cost plus the repair estimate.

steps.title: Split the reserve between indemnity and expense buckets
sop: Classify mitigation and repair amounts into the correct indemnity or expense bucket.
Enter each amount against its bucket on the reserve transaction.
Done when every amount sits in the correct reserve bucket.
verify: Review the bucket allocation against the company reserving guidance.
Pass when no mitigation or repair amount is booked to the wrong bucket.

steps.title: Route the reserve change for manager approval where required
sop: Compare the reserve movement to the approval threshold.
Route the transaction for approval where the movement exceeds the threshold.
Done when the correct approval is obtained or the movement is below threshold.
verify: Check the approval record against the movement size.
Pass when no above-threshold movement is posted without recorded approval.

steps.title: Post the reserve change in the claims platform
sop: Enter the reserve transaction with the derived figures and bucket split.
Submit the transaction so it posts against the correct exposure.
Done when the reserve transaction is posted on the claim.
verify: Open the reserve history and confirm the new balance and exposure.
Pass when the posted reserve equals the derived figure on the right exposure.

steps.title: Record the rationale note citing estimate and invoice figures
sop: Write the rationale note naming the estimate version and invoice totals used.
Attach the note to the reserve transaction on the claim.
Done when the rationale note is saved against the transaction.
verify: Read the note and confirm it cites both the estimate and invoice figures.
Pass when the transaction carries a rationale note citing both sources.

generic.Defined scope/population: The insured or claimant contact and inspection appointment for this newly assigned claim.
generic.In-scope period: From assignment receipt to the written appointment confirmation being sent and logged.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Primary phone, email, inspection date, time window and property or vehicle location on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every contact attempt on the claim has a logged outcome and the final attempt ends in an appointment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Call notes and the written appointment confirmation retained on the claim with dates and times.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unsuccessful attempts logged with date, time and the next action taken on the secondary contact.
generic.Test population: Inspection appointments booked on assigned claims in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any contact attempt is made without a logged timestamp and outcome.
generic.Exception handling path: Repeated no-contact escalates to the field claims adjuster for a direct approach before closing attempts.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Confirmed inspection date and time recorded with verified insured contact details.
generic.Evidence location: Claim contact log and appointment record in the claims management platform plus the email confirmation.

steps.title: Call the insured on the primary FNOL number and verify identity
sop: Open the claim and call the primary number captured at first notice of loss.
Verify identity against the name, address and policy number on the claim record.
Done when the caller identity is verified against the claim record.
verify: Check the identity verification note names the details confirmed.
Pass when the claim records a completed identity verification.

steps.title: Agree the inspection date, time window and location
sop: Offer available inspection slots and agree a date and time window.
Confirm the property address or vehicle location where the inspection will happen.
Done when date, window and location are agreed and recorded.
verify: Read back the agreed slot and location before ending the call.
Pass when the claim shows an agreed date, time window and location.

steps.title: Confirm the best contact channel and refresh contact details
sop: Ask the insured for the preferred contact channel and best number.
Update the phone and email fields on the claim where they have changed.
Done when the contact details on the claim are current.
verify: Compare the stored contact details to those confirmed on the call.
Pass when claim contact details match those confirmed by the insured.

steps.title: Log unsuccessful attempts and use the secondary contact
sop: Log each unsuccessful attempt with date, time and outcome on the claim.
Try the secondary contact before treating the attempt cycle as exhausted.
Done when every attempt is logged and the secondary contact is tried.
verify: Count logged attempts and confirm each carries a timestamp and outcome.
Pass when no attempt is recorded without a timestamp and outcome.

steps.title: Send the written appointment confirmation
sop: Send the confirmation by email or Teams stating date, window, location and contact.
Include what the insured should have available for the inspection.
Done when the written confirmation is sent to the insured.
verify: Compare the sent confirmation to the agreed appointment details.
Pass when the confirmation matches the agreed date, window and location.

steps.title: Record the appointment and notify the field adjuster
sop: Record the appointment on the claim and file the sent confirmation.
Notify the field claims adjuster of the booked slot and access notes.
Done when the appointment is recorded and the adjuster is notified.
verify: Open the claim and confirm the appointment record and filed confirmation.
Pass when the claim holds the appointment record and the sent confirmation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Vendor acceptances outstanding against dispatched assignments on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From dispatch send to the assignment status being set to Accepted or re-dispatched.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assignment ID, accepting contact name, acceptance timestamp and committed first-contact date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each dispatched assignment has exactly one recorded acceptance or one recorded re-dispatch.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Vendor acceptance message retained against the assignment with the received timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vendor caveats or scope queries logged with the resolution before status moves to Accepted.
generic.Test population: Dispatched vendor assignments awaiting acceptance in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any assignment stays unaccepted beyond the network response SLA.
generic.Exception handling path: No acceptance inside the response window triggers re-dispatch to the next qualified vendor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment status reads Accepted with acceptance timestamp and vendor contact recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Vendor assignment record and status history in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Check the vendor reply names the specific assignment ID
sop: Open the vendor reply and locate the assignment ID it references.
Reject generic acknowledgements that do not name the assignment.
Done when the reply is confirmed to reference this assignment ID.
verify: Compare the assignment ID in the reply to the dispatched assignment.
Pass when the acceptance names the correct assignment ID.

steps.title: Record the accepting contact and committed first-contact date
sop: Record the name of the vendor contact who accepted the assignment.
Record the committed first-contact or inspection date on the assignment.
Done when contact name and committed date are saved on the assignment.
verify: Reopen the assignment and check both fields are populated.
Pass when the assignment shows an accepting contact and a committed date.

steps.title: Verify the accepted scope matches the dispatched scope
sop: Compare the scope described in the acceptance to the dispatched scope.
Query any vendor-added caveat, exclusion or condition before accepting it.
Done when the accepted scope is confirmed equal to the dispatched scope.
verify: Check that no unresolved vendor caveat remains on the assignment.
Pass when the accepted scope matches dispatch with no open caveats.

steps.title: Set the assignment status to Accepted in the claims platform
sop: Change the assignment status from Dispatched to Accepted.
Confirm the SLA clock moves from response to the first-contact stage.
Done when the status is Accepted and the SLA stage has advanced.
verify: Open the status history and check the Accepted entry and timestamp.
Pass when the status history shows Accepted with an acceptance timestamp.

steps.title: Trigger re-dispatch where acceptance is not recorded in time
sop: Monitor unaccepted assignments against the network response window.
Trigger re-dispatch to the next qualified vendor once the window expires.
Done when every overdue assignment is re-dispatched or accepted.
verify: List assignments past the response SLA and check each has an action.
Pass when no assignment is left unaccepted beyond the response SLA.

steps.title: File the acceptance evidence against the assignment
sop: Attach the vendor acceptance message to the assignment record.
Record the received timestamp alongside the attachment.
Done when the acceptance evidence is filed with its timestamp.
verify: Open the assignment and confirm the acceptance evidence is attached.
Pass when the assignment holds the acceptance message and timestamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: Assignments dispatched to network contractors, body shops or restoration firms on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From vendor selection to the dispatch being sent and the follow-up diary created.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vendor ID, loss details, peril, coverage cap, access information and SLA targets on the dispatch.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One dispatched assignment exists per required service with no duplicate vendor assignments.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dispatch package and system timestamp retained on the assignment record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vendors skipped for capacity or hold status logged with the reason on the routing note.
generic.Test population: Network vendor assignments dispatched on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any assignment is dispatched to a vendor flagged Inactive or On Hold.
generic.Exception handling path: No qualified active vendor in area escalates to the vendor coordinator for an out-of-network approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dispatched assignment exists with vendor ID, scope and SLA targets recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Vendor assignment record and diary in the claims management platform plus the email or Teams send.

steps.title: Confirm the vendor is Active in the network directory
sop: Open the vendor record in the network directory in the claims platform.
Check the status is Active and no hold or remediation flag is set.
Done when the vendor is confirmed Active and unflagged.
verify: Read the vendor status and flag fields on the directory record.
Pass when the vendor status is Active with no hold or remediation flag.

steps.title: Attach loss details, peril, cap and access to the dispatch package
sop: Assemble the loss description, peril, coverage cap and access information.
Attach them to the dispatch package on the assignment.
Done when the dispatch package holds all four elements.
verify: Open the package and confirm each element is present and readable.
Pass when loss details, peril, cap and access are all in the package.

steps.title: Send the dispatch through the claims system to capture the timestamp
sop: Send the dispatch through the claims management platform rather than direct email.
Confirm the assignment ID and dispatch timestamp are captured by the system.
Done when the dispatch is sent with a system assignment ID and timestamp.
verify: Open the assignment and check the ID and dispatch timestamp exist.
Pass when the assignment holds a system ID and dispatch timestamp.

steps.title: Set the response and first-contact SLA targets on the assignment
sop: Read the contracted response and first-contact SLA for this vendor and service.
Enter both target dates on the assignment record.
Done when both SLA targets are saved on the assignment.
verify: Compare the entered targets to the contracted SLA for the service type.
Pass when the assignment SLA targets match the contracted commitments.

steps.title: Notify the vendor contact by email or Teams
sop: Send the vendor contact a notification pointing to the dispatched assignment.
Include the claim number, service required and required response time.
Done when the vendor contact has been notified outside the system as well.
verify: Check the notification names the assignment and the response deadline.
Pass when the notification carries the assignment reference and deadline.

steps.title: Create the follow-up diary for acceptance and first contact
sop: Create a diary dated on the response SLA to verify acceptance.
Create a second diary on the first-contact SLA date.
Done when both follow-up diaries exist on the claim.
verify: Check both diary dates against the SLA targets on the assignment.
Pass when diaries exist for both the response and first-contact SLA dates.

generic.Defined scope/population: Preferred vendor networks available for this loss type, line of business and loss geography.
generic.In-scope period: From loss type confirmation to the selected network being recorded on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss type, line of business, loss state and ZIP, network name and routing rule reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The selected network has an active fee schedule covering the loss state and ZIP with no gap.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Network selection note and the fee schedule version referenced retained on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Programme constraints or mandated vendors logged with the source of the mandate.
generic.Test population: Network selections recorded on claims in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a network is selected with no active fee schedule for the loss geography.
generic.Exception handling path: Geographies with no active network escalate for an out-of-network authorization before dispatch.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Selected vendor network recorded on the claim with the routing rule reference applied.
generic.Evidence location: Claim network selection note in the claims platform and the contract lifecycle management repository.

steps.title: Identify the loss type that drives network selection
sop: Read the loss description and classify the service needed.
Record whether it is auto physical damage, property restoration, contents, glass or tow.
Done when the driving loss type is recorded on the claim.
verify: Check the recorded loss type against the loss description and peril.
Pass when the loss type recorded matches the documented loss.

steps.title: Filter the network directory by line of business and service area
sop: Open the network directory in the claims platform.
Filter by line of business and by the loss state and ZIP service area.
Done when the candidate networks for this loss are listed.
verify: Check each listed network covers the loss ZIP in its service area.
Pass when every candidate network covers the loss geography.

steps.title: Confirm an active fee schedule exists in the loss geography
sop: Open the contract lifecycle management repository for the candidate network.
Confirm the fee schedule is executed, in date and covers the loss state.
Done when an active fee schedule is confirmed for the geography.
verify: Check the fee schedule effective and expiry dates against the loss date.
Pass when the fee schedule is in force for the loss date and state.

steps.title: Check programme constraints on network choice
sop: Check for direct repair programme participation or catastrophe surge routing.
Check for a client-mandated or policy-mandated vendor on this account.
Done when all applicable programme constraints are identified.
verify: Read each identified constraint and confirm its source is documented.
Pass when every constraint applied cites its source on the claim.

steps.title: Select the network and apply the routing rule
sop: Select the network satisfying loss type, geography, contract and constraints.
Apply the routing rule that governs vendor order within that network.
Done when the network is selected under a named routing rule.
verify: Check the applied routing rule matches the network and loss type.
Pass when the selection is governed by a named routing rule.

steps.title: Record the network selection on the claim
sop: Record the selected network and the routing rule reference on the claim.
Note the fee schedule version relied on for the selection.
Done when the selection, rule and schedule version are recorded.
verify: Open the claim note and confirm all three elements are present.
Pass when the claim records network, routing rule and fee schedule version.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assignment package issued to the selected vendor for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From vendor selection to the package being sent and filed against the assignment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, coverage summary, loss description, date of loss, contacts, scope, cap and invoice terms.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attachments listed in the package cover letter equal the attachments actually sent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent copy of the package filed against the vendor assignment with the send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents withheld for privacy or privilege logged with the reason on the assignment.
generic.Test population: Assignment packages issued to vendors on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any assignment is marked Issued without an attached assignment package.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing source documents pause issue and route back to the claims adjuster for supply.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Issued assignment package retained on the claim with the send date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Vendor assignment record in the claims platform and the claim file document repository.

steps.title: Assemble the core claim details for the package
sop: Collect the claim number, policy and coverage summary and date of loss.
Add the loss description in the words recorded at first notice.
Done when the core claim details are assembled in the package.
verify: Check each core detail against the claim record.
Pass when claim number, coverage summary, loss description and date match the claim.

steps.title: Add the insured contact details and confirmed access window
sop: Add the insured or claimant name, phone and email from the claim record.
Add the confirmed access window and any access constraints.
Done when contacts and access details are included in the package.
verify: Compare package contacts to the current contacts on the claim.
Pass when package contacts and access window match the claim record.

steps.title: State the authorized scope, cap and invoice requirements
sop: State the authorized scope of work and the dollar cap for the assignment.
State the invoice submission requirements including required supporting evidence.
Done when scope, cap and invoice terms are stated in the package.
verify: Read the package and confirm all three statements are explicit.
Pass when the package states scope, cap and invoice requirements.

steps.title: Attach FNOL photos, prior estimates and reports
sop: Pull FNOL photos, any prior estimate and police or fire reports from the claim file.
Attach the relevant documents and list them in the package cover.
Done when all relevant supporting documents are attached and listed.
verify: Count the listed attachments against the documents actually attached.
Pass when the attachment list equals the documents sent.

steps.title: Send the assignment package to the vendor
sop: Send the package to the accepted vendor contact for the assignment.
Confirm the send completes and capture the send date and recipient.
Done when the package is sent and the send date is captured.
verify: Check the send record names the vendor contact and the date.
Pass when the send record shows the recipient and send date.

steps.title: File the sent copy against the vendor assignment record
sop: Save the sent copy of the package to the claim file repository.
Link it to the vendor assignment and set the status to Issued.
Done when the sent copy is filed and the assignment reads Issued.
verify: Open the assignment and confirm the filed package and Issued status.
Pass when no assignment reads Issued without an attached package.

generic.Defined scope/population: Vendor assignment records created in the claims system for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From vendor dispatch to the assignment appearing on the claim timeline with the correct status.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vendor ID, network, service type, assignment date, authorized amount and SLA target dates.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assignment records on the claim equal the number of vendors actually engaged on the loss.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment record and initial contact confirmation stored with date and time stamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assignments with missing vendor data logged and held until the record is completed.
generic.Test population: Vendor assignment records logged on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any assignment record has a blank vendor ID or a missing contact confirmation.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete assignment records route back to the claims coordinator before the status is advanced.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment record shows vendor, service type, authorized amount and initial contact confirmation.
generic.Evidence location: Vendor assignment record and claim timeline in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Create the vendor assignment record in the claims platform
sop: Open the claim and create a new vendor assignment record.
Enter the vendor ID, network, service type and assignment date.
Done when the assignment record exists with all four fields populated.
verify: Reopen the record and check no core field is blank.
Pass when vendor ID, network, service type and date are all populated.

steps.title: Record the initial vendor to insured contact confirmation
sop: Obtain the date and time the vendor first contacted the insured.
Record the confirmation against the assignment record.
Done when the initial contact date and time are recorded.
verify: Check the recorded contact time against the vendor confirmation message.
Pass when the assignment shows the initial contact date and time.

steps.title: Enter the authorized amount and SLA target dates
sop: Enter the authorized dollar amount for the assignment.
Enter the response, first-contact and completion SLA target dates.
Done when the authorized amount and all SLA targets are entered.
verify: Compare the entered amount and targets to the authorization and contract.
Pass when amount and SLA targets match the authorization and contract.

steps.title: Link the assignment to the correct exposure and coverage
sop: Identify the exposure and coverage the vendor work is performed under.
Link the assignment record to that exposure in the claims platform.
Done when the assignment is linked to the correct exposure.
verify: Open the exposure and confirm the assignment appears against it.
Pass when the assignment sits under the correct exposure and coverage.

steps.title: Save the record and confirm it appears on the claim timeline
sop: Save the assignment record and refresh the claim timeline.
Confirm the assignment appears with the expected status.
Done when the assignment is visible on the claim timeline.
verify: Read the timeline entry and check the status matches the real stage.
Pass when the timeline shows the assignment with the correct status.

steps.title: Hold and correct incomplete assignment records
sop: Review the saved record for blank vendor ID or missing contact confirmation.
Return incomplete records for correction before advancing the status.
Done when no incomplete assignment record remains on the claim.
verify: Run the assignment list and check for blank required fields.
Pass when no assignment record has a blank vendor ID or contact confirmation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Qualified network vendors capable of handling this claim severity, specialism and geography.
generic.In-scope period: From network selection to the chosen vendor and rationale being recorded on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss severity, specialism, drive radius, capacity, scorecard tier and credential status per candidate.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Candidate shortlist counts reconcile to the directory filter results for capability and radius.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Selection note with the scorecard extract used retained on the claim with the extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vendors excluded for capacity, credentials or remediation logged with the exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: Vendor selections made for assignments on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an assignment is made to a vendor with an expired credential or a remediation hold.
generic.Exception handling path: No qualified vendor within radius escalates to the claims adjuster for an out-of-area approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Selected vendor recorded with capability, geography and scorecard rationale.
generic.Evidence location: Claim selection note in the claims platform plus the Excel candidate comparison worksheet.

steps.title: Match loss severity and specialism to vendor capability
sop: Classify the loss by severity and by specialism such as structural, water or contents.
Filter the directory for vendors approved for that specialism and severity band.
Done when the capability-matched candidate list is produced.
verify: Check each candidate is approved for the required specialism.
Pass when no candidate lacks the required specialism approval.

steps.title: Filter candidates by drive radius from the loss location
sop: Apply the acceptable drive radius from the loss location to the candidate list.
Remove candidates outside the radius unless an exception is approved.
Done when only in-radius candidates remain on the list.
verify: Check each remaining candidate distance against the radius threshold.
Pass when every candidate sits inside the approved drive radius.

steps.title: Check current capacity and open assignment count
sop: Pull the open assignment count and stated capacity for each candidate.
Remove candidates at or above their capacity ceiling.
Done when capacity is checked for every remaining candidate.
verify: Compare each candidate open count to its capacity ceiling.
Pass when no selected vendor is at or above its capacity ceiling.

steps.title: Review the vendor scorecard and remediation status
sop: Open the scorecard extract for cycle time, rework rate and CSAT.
Exclude vendors under remediation or below the performance floor.
Done when scorecard and remediation status are reviewed for all candidates.
verify: Check no candidate carries an open remediation flag.
Pass when the selected vendor is free of remediation holds.

steps.title: Confirm credential currency for the selected vendor
sop: Check licence, insurance certificate and trade certification expiry dates.
Reject the candidate where any credential has lapsed.
Done when the selected vendor credentials are confirmed current.
verify: Compare each credential expiry date to today.
Pass when no credential on the selected vendor has expired.

steps.title: Record the selected vendor and the selection rationale
sop: Record the chosen vendor on the claim with capability, radius and scorecard reasons.
Save the candidate comparison worksheet against the claim.
Done when the selection and rationale are recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the selection note and confirm all three rationale elements.
Pass when the note cites capability, geography and scorecard rationale.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open vendor assignments with contracted SLA stages in the monitoring cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The current monitoring cycle from the last SLA review to the exception list being published.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Acknowledgement, first-contact and inspection timestamps present on every open assignment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assignments in the SLA report equal the open assignment count in the claims platform.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: SLA attainment report saved with the extract date and the reporting period covered.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each breach logged with the chase action taken and the vendor response recorded.
generic.Test population: Open vendor assignments with SLA stages during the monitoring cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any SLA breach older than the escalation window has no logged chase action.
generic.Exception handling path: First-contact breaches are chased the same day and repeat breaches recorded against the vendor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: SLA attainment report produced with per-assignment elapsed times and breach flags.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform SLA dashboard plus assignment records in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Pull SLA stage timestamps for open assignments
sop: Extract acknowledgement, first-contact and inspection timestamps from the claims platform.
Load them into the BI reporting platform for the monitoring cycle.
Done when timestamps for every open assignment are extracted.
verify: Compare the extracted assignment count to the open count in the claims platform.
Pass when extracted and system assignment counts agree.

steps.title: Calculate elapsed time against contracted SLA per stage
sop: Calculate elapsed time from dispatch to each stage timestamp.
Compare each elapsed time to the contracted SLA for that stage.
Done when elapsed time and SLA comparison exist for every stage.
verify: Recompute a sample of elapsed times against the raw timestamps.
Pass when sampled elapsed times match the report figures.

steps.title: Flag assignments breaching stage SLAs
sop: Flag every assignment where elapsed time exceeds the contracted SLA.
Group the flags by vendor and by SLA stage.
Done when every breaching assignment carries a breach flag.
verify: Check flagged records against the calculated elapsed times.
Pass when every assignment over SLA carries a breach flag.

steps.title: Chase first-contact breaches the same day
sop: Contact the vendor for each first-contact SLA breach on the day it is identified.
Record the chase action, contact name and vendor commitment on the assignment.
Done when every first-contact breach has a same-day chase logged.
verify: Compare chase log dates to the breach identification dates.
Pass when no first-contact breach lacks a same-day chase entry.

steps.title: Record repeat breaches against the vendor record
sop: Identify vendors with repeat breaches across the cycle.
Record the repeat breach count on the vendor record for the quarterly scorecard.
Done when repeat breaches are recorded against each vendor.
verify: Check the vendor record breach count against the report figures.
Pass when vendor record breach counts match the SLA report.

steps.title: Publish the SLA exception list to the coordinator queue
sop: Produce the exception list of breaching assignments with owners and actions.
Publish it to the vendor coordinator queue for action.
Done when the exception list is published for the cycle.
