generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved amounts in the letter sum to the revised total stated in the letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent letter retained in the claim file repository with recipients and send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines left open pending documentation logged with the evidence requested.
generic.Test population: Estimate variance findings letters issued on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a variance letter is issued without a diary for the contractor response.
generic.Exception handling path: Undeliverable letters route back for address verification and reissue within the service standard.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Variance findings letter on file with recipients, send date and a diary for the response.
generic.Evidence location: Claim file document repository plus the correspondence log in the claims platform.

steps.title: Draft the variance letter from the itemised discrepancy list
sop: Open the itemised discrepancy list recorded on the claim.
Draft the letter listing each disputed line with estimate and approved amounts.
Done when every disputed line appears in the draft letter.
verify: Compare the letter lines to the discrepancy list.
Pass when the letter covers every line on the discrepancy list.

steps.title: State the basis for each adjustment
sop: Add the basis for each adjustment as price guideline, scope evidence or coverage.
Keep the basis specific to the line rather than a general statement.
Done when every adjusted line has a stated basis.
verify: Read each basis and confirm it names the guideline or provision.
Pass when no adjusted line lacks a specific basis.

steps.title: Include the revised total and the reconsideration route
sop: State the revised estimate total resulting from the adjustments.
State what documentation would support reconsideration of each line.
Done when the revised total and reconsideration route are in the letter.
verify: Sum the approved amounts and compare to the stated revised total.
Pass when the approved amounts equal the stated revised total.

steps.title: Send the letter to the contractor and copy the insured
sop: Use the contractor and insured addresses held on the claim record.
Send the letter to the contractor and copy the insured.
Done when the letter is sent to both parties.
verify: Compare the addresses used to those on the claim record.
Pass when the letter was sent to the addresses held on the claim.

steps.title: File the sent letter on the claim
sop: Save the sent letter to the claim file repository.
Record the recipients and the send date against the document.
Done when the letter is filed with recipients and send date.
verify: Open the claim file and confirm the letter, recipients and date.
Pass when the filed letter shows recipients and send date.

steps.title: Set the diary for the contractor response
sop: Create a diary dated at the response deadline stated in the letter.
Set the action to chase the contractor if no response is received.
Done when the response diary exists on the claim.
verify: Check the diary date against the response deadline in the letter.
Pass when a diary exists for the contractor response deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Disputed scope and pricing lines being negotiated with the contractor on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the variance letter response to the revised approved estimate version being issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line position, contracted rate, conceded amount, evidence reference and final agreed total.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Final agreed total equals the sum of the agreed positions on every disputed line.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Negotiation record and the revised estimate version retained with dates and version numbers.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each conceded line logged with the new evidence that changed the position.
generic.Test population: Disputed estimate lines negotiated on the claim in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any agreed rate exceeds the contracted fee schedule without documented approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Positions above settlement authority escalate before any figure is committed to the contractor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Negotiation record shows the agreed position per disputed line and the final agreed total.
generic.Evidence location: Negotiation notes in the claims platform plus the revised estimate in CCC or Mitchell.

steps.title: Open the negotiation from the itemised variance list
sop: Open the itemised variance list and take each line in turn.
Avoid opening on a lump-sum figure that hides the line detail.
Done when the negotiation opens on the itemised positions.
verify: Check the negotiation record starts from itemised lines.
Pass when the record shows line-level rather than lump-sum positions.

steps.title: Hold labour and material rates to the contracted fee schedule
sop: Read the contracted rates for labour and materials in the loss geography.
Hold the negotiating position at those contracted rates.
Done when the rate position is anchored to the fee schedule.
verify: Compare each agreed rate to the contracted schedule.
Pass when no agreed rate exceeds the contracted fee schedule.

steps.title: Concede only lines supported by new evidence
sop: Require new evidence such as photos or teardown before conceding a line.
Record the evidence that changed the position for each concession.
Done when every concession names its supporting evidence.
verify: Read each concession and confirm the evidence reference.
Pass when no concession is recorded without supporting evidence.

steps.title: Confirm the agreed total sits within settlement authority
sop: Total the agreed positions across all disputed lines.
Compare the total to the settlement authority before committing.
Done when the authority check is completed and recorded.
verify: Check the agreed total against the authority tier of the handler.
Pass when the agreed total sits inside the handler settlement authority.

steps.title: Record the final agreed scope and pricing
sop: Record the agreed position for each disputed line on the claim.
Record the final agreed total and the date agreement was reached.
Done when the agreed positions and total are recorded.
verify: Sum the recorded line positions and compare to the final total.
Pass when line positions sum to the recorded final agreed total.

steps.title: Issue the revised approved estimate version
sop: Update the estimate in CCC or Mitchell to the agreed scope and pricing.
Issue the revised version and notify the contractor of the approved figure.
Done when the revised approved version is issued and notified.
verify: Open the estimate history and confirm the revised approved version.
Pass when the revised version matches the recorded agreed total.

generic.Defined scope/population: The total-loss vehicle on this claim and the comparable vehicles returned by the valuation tool.
generic.In-scope period: From the total-loss determination to the valuation report being attached to the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: VIN, mileage, trim, options, condition grade, comparable list and adjustment basis per comparable.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Settlement value equals base comparable value plus documented adjustments, taxes and fees.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Full valuation report attached to the claim with the tool run date and report version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Comparables removed for radius or date logged with the reason on the valuation note.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a settlement value is recorded without an attached valuation report.
generic.Exception handling path: Thin comparable sets escalate for a wider search or a second valuation source before use.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Valuation report attached showing comparables and itemised adjustments.
generic.Evidence location: Valuation report in CCC or Mitchell attached to the claim in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Enter vehicle identity and condition into the valuation tool
sop: Enter VIN, mileage, trim and factory options into CCC or Mitchell.
Enter the condition grade supported by the inspection photos.
Done when all identity and condition inputs are entered.
verify: Check the entered VIN and mileage against the inspection record.
Pass when tool inputs match the inspected vehicle record.

steps.title: Review returned comparables for radius and date validity
sop: Review the comparable vehicles returned by the tool.
Remove comparables outside the acceptable radius or listing date range.
Done when only valid comparables remain in the set.
verify: Check each retained comparable radius and listing date.
Pass when every retained comparable is inside radius and date range.

steps.title: Apply and document condition and mileage adjustments
sop: Apply condition, mileage and prior-damage adjustments to each comparable.
Record the basis for each adjustment in the valuation note.
Done when every adjustment carries a documented basis.
verify: Read each adjustment and confirm the basis is stated.
Pass when no adjustment is applied without a documented basis.

steps.title: Add applicable taxes, title and registration fees
sop: Read the state requirement for taxes, title and registration on total losses.
Add the applicable amounts to the settlement calculation.
Done when all state-required amounts are included.
verify: Check the added amounts against the state requirement.
Pass when taxes and fees match the state requirement for the loss state.

steps.title: Attach the valuation report to the claim
sop: Export the full valuation report including comparables and adjustments.
Attach it to the claim in the claims management platform.
Done when the complete report is attached to the claim.
verify: Open the attached report and confirm comparables and adjustments appear.
Pass when the attached report shows comparables and itemised adjustments.

steps.title: Record the settlement value on the claim
sop: Record the settlement value derived from the valuation report.
Reference the report version in the claim note.
Done when the settlement value and report reference are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded value to the figure in the attached report.
Pass when the recorded settlement value equals the report figure.

generic.Defined scope/population: The vehicle exposure on this claim being closed after total-loss settlement.
generic.In-scope period: From payment clearance to the claim file status being set to Closed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payment status, title transfer status, lien satisfaction, salvage assignment and closure reason.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Incurred equals paid on the closed exposure with reserves zeroed to nil.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closure note, title and payment evidence retained in the claim file with the closure date.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any open reserve or pending payment remains on the closed vehicle exposure.
generic.Exception handling path: Outstanding title or lien items block closure and route back to the auto claims specialist.

generic.Evidence location: Exposure financials and closure record in the claims platform plus the claim file repository.

steps.title: Confirm the total-loss payment has cleared
sop: Open the claim financials and check the total-loss payment status.
Confirm no pending payment or refund remains open on the exposure.
Done when payment clearance is confirmed.
verify: Check the payment ledger for pending or returned items.
Pass when no pending payment or refund remains on the exposure.

steps.title: Verify title transfer, lien satisfaction and salvage assignment
sop: Check title transfer, lien satisfaction and salvage assignment records.
Confirm each is recorded as complete on the claim.
Done when all three are confirmed complete.
verify: Open each record and check the completion status and date.
Pass when title, lien and salvage records are all complete.

steps.title: Confirm recoveries sit on an open recovery exposure
sop: Check for open subrogation or salvage recovery on the claim.
Confirm each is held on a recovery exposure that stays open after closure.
Done when every open recovery sits on a recovery exposure.
verify: List open recoveries and check their exposure assignment.
Pass when no recovery is lost by closing the indemnity exposure.

steps.title: Zero out remaining reserves on the exposure
sop: Reduce the remaining indemnity and expense reserves to nil.
Confirm incurred equals paid on the exposure after the change.
Done when reserves are zeroed and incurred equals paid.
verify: Compare incurred and paid on the exposure financial summary.
Pass when incurred equals paid with nil reserves remaining.

steps.title: Set the closure reason to total loss settled
sop: Select the total-loss settled closure reason on the exposure.
Record the closure note referencing the settlement and title completion.
Done when the closure reason and note are recorded.
verify: Read the closure record and confirm the reason and note.
Pass when the closure reason reads total loss settled with a note.

steps.title: Close the file and confirm the status change
sop: Close the exposure and the claim file in the claims platform.
Refresh and confirm the status reads Closed.
Done when the file status shows Closed.
verify: Reopen the claim and check the status and closure date.
Pass when the claim status reads Closed with a closure date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Title and lienholder payoff documentation required to settle this total-loss vehicle.

steps.title: Request the signed title from the registered owner

Confirm the signature matches the titled owner name on receipt.
Done when the signed title is received and the signature checked.
verify: Compare the signature name to the titled owner on the title document.
Pass when the signature matches the titled owner name.

steps.title: Obtain the lienholder payoff letter

Check the letter states the payoff amount and the good-through date.
Done when a payoff letter is held for every lienholder.

Pass when every recorded lienholder has a payoff letter on file.

steps.title: Confirm odometer disclosure and any affidavit or power of attorney
sop: Check the odometer disclosure is completed as the state requires.

Done when all supporting title documents are held.
verify: Check each supporting document is signed and complete.
Pass when odometer disclosure and any affidavit are complete.

steps.title: Check title state and brand status against the vehicle record
sop: Compare the title issuing state and brand status to the claim vehicle record.
Query any mismatch before the title is relied on for settlement.
Done when state and brand status are confirmed consistent.
verify: Compare the VIN and brand on the title to the claim vehicle record.
Pass when VIN, state and brand agree with the claim record.

steps.title: Index the title and payoff letter to the claim
sop: Upload the signed title and payoff letters to the claim file repository.
Index them under the total-loss documentation type.
Done when both documents are indexed to the claim.
verify: Filter claim documents on the total-loss index and check both return.
Pass when both title and payoff letter appear under the index.

steps.title: Log receipt of the original documents
sop: Record the date the original title and payoff letter were received.
Update the document checklist so the payment gate can be released.
Done when receipt of originals is logged on the claim.
verify: Read the document checklist and confirm both items are marked received.
Pass when the checklist shows both originals received with dates.

generic.Defined scope/population: The damaged vehicle on this claim being tested against the state total-loss threshold.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the exposure flag conflicts with the recorded threshold calculation.
generic.Exception handling path: Borderline cases refer to the claims examiner for a documented decision before flagging.

generic.Evidence location: Calculation note and exposure flag in the claims platform plus the estimate in CCC or Mitchell.

steps.title: Total the repair estimate including supplements and teardown
sop: Open the repair estimate and add expected supplements and teardown cost.
Record the combined repair cost figure on the claim.
Done when the combined repair cost is recorded.
verify: Recompute the total from the estimate, supplements and teardown.
Pass when the recorded repair cost matches the recomputed total.

steps.title: Establish actual cash value from the valuation tool
sop: Run or open the valuation in CCC or Mitchell for the vehicle.
Record the actual cash value used and its report reference.
Done when the ACV and its source are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded ACV to the valuation report figure.
Pass when the recorded ACV equals the valuation report value.

steps.title: Apply the state total-loss formula or percentage threshold
sop: Identify the total-loss formula or percentage applying in the loss state.
Apply it to the repair cost and ACV figures recorded.
Done when the threshold formula is applied and the result recorded.
verify: Recompute the formula from the recorded inputs.
Pass when the recorded result matches the recomputed formula.

steps.title: Add expected salvage value where the formula requires it
sop: Obtain the expected salvage value for the vehicle and damage grade.
Include it in the comparison where the state formula requires it.
Done when salvage value is included or its exclusion is justified.
verify: Check the salvage treatment against the state formula definition.
Pass when salvage is treated as the state formula requires.

steps.title: Record the calculation and inputs on the claim
sop: Write the calculation note listing repair cost, ACV and salvage inputs.
Save the note against the vehicle exposure.
Done when the calculation and all inputs are recorded.
verify: Read the note and confirm every input value is present.
Pass when the note records repair cost, ACV and salvage inputs.

steps.title: Set the exposure to repairable or total loss
sop: Set the exposure flag to match the threshold calculation result.
Notify the handler so downstream tasks follow the correct path.
Done when the exposure flag matches the calculation.
verify: Compare the exposure flag to the recorded calculation result.
Pass when the exposure flag is consistent with the calculation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Salvage or branded title applications required for this total-loss asset in the loss state.
generic.In-scope period: From the salvage decision to the returned branded title or DMV confirmation being filed.

generic.Exception handling path: DMV rejections route back for correction and resubmission inside the state filing deadline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: DMV application and confirmation retained on the claim against the salvage record.
generic.Evidence location: Claim file document repository plus the salvage record in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Confirm the correct branded title type for the loss state
sop: Read the state rules for salvage, junk, non-repairable and rebuilt brands.
Select the brand type matching the damage and the disposal intent.
Done when the correct brand type is selected and recorded.
verify: Check the selected brand against the state rule and damage level.
Pass when the brand type matches the state rule for this damage.

steps.title: Complete the state application with vehicle and owner detail
sop: Complete the application with VIN, owner details and lienholder release.
Add the damage disclosure required by the state form.
Done when the application is complete with all required fields.
verify: Check every mandatory field on the form is populated.
Pass when no mandatory application field is blank.

steps.title: Submit the application with the signed title and fee
sop: Assemble the application, the signed title and the filing fee.
Submit the package inside the state filing deadline.
Done when the package is submitted before the deadline.
verify: Compare the submission date to the state filing deadline.
Pass when submission occurred inside the state deadline.

steps.title: Record the submission details on the claim
sop: Record the submission date, method and tracking or reference number.
Attach the submitted application copy to the claim.
Done when submission details and the copy are recorded.
verify: Open the claim and confirm the details and attached copy.
Pass when the claim holds the submission date, reference and copy.

steps.title: Chase and file the returned branded title or confirmation
sop: Diary the expected DMV turnaround and chase if it passes.
File the returned branded title or confirmation against the salvage record.
Done when the DMV response is received and filed.
verify: Open the salvage record and confirm the DMV response is attached.
Pass when the salvage record holds the returned title or confirmation.

steps.title: Gate auction release on the recorded title filing
sop: Check the title filing record before releasing the asset to auction.
Hold release where the filing is not yet recorded.

verify: Check released assets against their title filing records.
Pass when no asset was released without a recorded title filing.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any owner-retained asset appears on the salvage-eligible list.

generic.Evidence location: Salvage eligibility worksheet in Excel plus the asset records in the claims platform.

steps.title: Filter settled total-loss exposures for company-owned assets

Filter for assets where the company has taken ownership.
Done when the company-owned asset list is produced.

Pass when every listed asset is recorded as company owned.

steps.title: Exclude owner-retained assets and record the election
sop: Identify assets where the owner elected retention at settlement.
Record the retention election on the file and remove them from the list.

verify: Cross-check the eligible list against retention elections on file.
Pass when no owner-retained asset remains on the eligible list.

steps.title: Confirm residual value exceeds the disposal cost threshold

Compare it to the tow, storage and handling cost threshold.
Done when each asset is tested against the threshold.
verify: Recompute the value against cost for a sample of assets.
Pass when every eligible asset has residual value above cost.

steps.title: Flag assets requiring special handling
sop: Identify EV battery, flood, hazardous contents and heavy equipment assets.
Flag each for a specialist disposal channel.
Done when every special-handling asset is flagged.
verify: Check the flags against the asset damage and type records.
Pass when every special-handling asset carries its flag.

steps.title: Record the eligibility decision and reason per asset
sop: Record each asset as salvage-eligible or excluded on the worksheet.
State the reason for the decision against each asset.
Done when every asset has a decision and a reason.
verify: Count decisions against the assessed asset population.
Pass when every assessed asset carries a decision and reason.

steps.title: Route eligible assets to salvage disposition
sop: Send the eligible asset list into the salvage disposition queue.
Confirm each eligible asset now has a disposition task open.
Done when every eligible asset is routed to disposition.
verify: Compare open disposition tasks to the eligible asset list.
Pass when every eligible asset has an open disposition task.

verify: Reopen the assignment and check no asset field is blank.

steps.title: Select the approved salvage vendor or auction channel
sop: Filter approved salvage vendors by asset type and storage geography.
Select the vendor or auction channel and record the selection reason.

verify: Check the vendor is approved for the asset type and geography.

steps.title: Provide title status and expected release date

Provide the expected release date so the vendor can schedule pickup.
Done when title status and release date are on the assignment.
verify: Compare the title status recorded to the title documentation on file.
Pass when the recorded title status matches the documentation.

steps.title: Confirm storage charges stop or cap at pickup
sop: Confirm with the storage facility that charges stop at pickup.
Record the agreed stop or cap position on the assignment.
Done when the storage stop or cap is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Read the storage note and check the stop or cap is explicit.
Pass when the assignment records a storage stop or cap at pickup.

steps.title: Open the salvage recovery exposure
sop: Open a salvage recovery exposure in the payment and subrogation system.
Link it to the claim so proceeds can be tracked to closure.
Done when the recovery exposure exists and is linked.
verify: Open the claim and confirm the recovery exposure appears.
Pass when a salvage recovery exposure is open against the claim.

sop: Send the salvage assignment to the selected vendor.
Diary the expected pickup date to chase non-collection.

verify: Check the diary date against the expected pickup date.

steps.title: Review claimant-supplied comparables or dealer quotes

sop: Compare the proposed figure to the policy limit and settlement authority.

Done when the limit and authority checks are complete.
verify: Check the agreed figure against the limit and authority tier.
Pass when the agreed figure is inside limits and authority.

steps.title: Record the agreed settlement amount and date

Save the negotiation history against the claim.

verify: Open the settlement record and confirm amount, date and history.
Pass when the claim holds the agreed amount, date and negotiation history.

steps.title: Capture the claimant acceptance on the claim
sop: Obtain the claimant acceptance of the agreed figure.
Record the acceptance with the channel and date on the claim.

verify: Read the acceptance record and check channel and date are present.

verify: Open the claim note and confirm all limits and the version appear.

verify: Compare authorization dates to the limit verification date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Salvage dispositions on this claim ready for approval after proceeds reconciliation.

steps.title: Confirm the proceeds reconciliation is complete

Confirm variances to the booked reserve are explained.

steps.title: Verify title, lien release and storage deductions are settled

steps.title: Approve the disposition and record the net recovery

Record the approved net recovery amount on the salvage record.

verify: Reopen the salvage record and confirm approver ID and amount.

steps.title: Attach the remittance advice to the approval

verify: Open the approval and confirm the remittance advice is attached.

steps.title: Release the salvage record for recovery ledger posting
sop: Release the approved disposition to the payment and subrogation system.

verify: Check the payment system for the pending recovery posting.
Pass when the approved disposition appears for posting in the recovery ledger.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovered or damaged assets on this claim being assigned to a salvage pool or vendor.

verify: Check the selection covers the asset type and storage geography.

steps.title: Provide the pickup location and release authorisation

verify: Check the facility contact and release code are present.

steps.title: Set the expected pickup date and storage stop

Confirm storage accrual stops at pickup and record the position.
Done when the pickup date and storage stop are recorded.
verify: Read the storage note and confirm the stop position is explicit.
Pass when the assignment records the pickup date and storage stop.

steps.title: Save the assignment and confirm the reference appears

Confirm the assignment reference appears on the claim.
Done when the assignment reference is visible on the claim.
verify: Open the claim and read the assignment reference.
Pass when the claim shows the assignment with its reference.

steps.title: Monitor unassigned assets against the storage threshold

Assign or escalate any asset approaching the accrual threshold.
Done when no asset sits unassigned past the threshold.
verify: Check unassigned assets against their storage accrual days.
Pass when no asset exceeds the storage accrual threshold unassigned.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every lienholder recorded on the title or asset record for this salvage asset.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written release or payoff confirmation on file for every recorded lienholder.
generic.Evidence location: Claim file document repository plus the lien status field in the claims platform.

steps.title: Identify every recorded lienholder on the asset

List each lienholder with its contact details.

verify: Compare the list to the lien entries on the title.
Pass when the list covers every lien recorded on the title.

steps.title: Obtain a written release or payoff confirmation
sop: Request a written lien release or payoff confirmation from each lienholder.

steps.title: Verify the release names the correct asset and signatory

steps.title: Confirm payoff clearance where a payoff applies
sop: Check the payment record where a payoff rather than a release applies.

Done when payoff clearance is confirmed for each applicable lien.
verify: Check the payment ledger for cleared payoff transactions.
Pass when every payoff shows a cleared payment.

steps.title: Index the release documents to the claim
sop: Upload the releases and payoff confirmations to the claim file repository.
Index them against the salvage asset record.
Done when all documents are indexed to the claim.
verify: Filter the claim documents on the lien index and check completeness.
Pass when the index returns a document for every lienholder.

steps.title: Mark the lien status as clear on the asset record
sop: Set the lien status to clear on the salvage asset record.
Record the date and the supporting documents relied on.
Done when the lien status is marked clear with references.
verify: Check the lien-clear flag against the filed release documents.
Pass when no asset is lien-clear without supporting releases.

generic.Defined scope/population: Hazardous components on this salvage asset requiring controlled disposal evidence.

sop: Upload the manifest and certificate to the compliance evidence repository.

steps.title: Mark disposal compliance complete on the salvage record

verify: Check the compliance flag against the filed evidence.

Filter for total-loss and severely damaged assets.

Identify assets never taken into company custody and exclude both groups.

verify: Compare the eligible list to the open subrogation evidence holds.

verify: Check every row carries claim number, asset ID and location.

Pass when the recorded gross equals the remittance figure.

Record the net proceeds figure on the worksheet.

verify: Recompute gross less deductions and compare to the net.

sop: Apply the net proceeds against the recoverable balance on the claim.
Record the application in the payment and subrogation system.
Done when the net is applied to the recoverable balance.
verify: Check the recoverable balance movement equals the net applied.
Pass when the balance reduces by exactly the net proceeds.

sop: Record the balance still outstanding after the netting.

verify: Open the recovery record and confirm the remaining balance.
Pass when the remaining recoverable balance is recorded on the claim.

verify: Compare the ledger movement to the posted recovery amount.

sop: Open the claim financial summary after the posting.
Confirm the incurred figure reduces by the recovery amount.

verify: Compare the incurred movement to the posted recovery.

sop: Confirm the full approved amount has been posted.
Close the salvage recovery exposure on the claim.

verify: Open the exposure and check status and posted total.

verify: Check the reserve balance against received proceeds.

Feed the pattern into the salvage estimating assumptions.

verify: Check the assumption review record for the fed-back drivers.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assets with unclear title or disputed custody logged with the resolution action.

generic.Evidence location: Salvage custody record in the claims platform plus intake photos in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Confirm physical possession and facility details

Record them on the salvage custody record.
Done when possession and facility details are recorded.

Pass when custody details match the facility confirmation.

steps.title: Record the storage start date and daily rate

Confirm accrual is visible against the salvage record.
Done when the storage start date and rate are recorded.
verify: Recompute accrued storage from the start date and rate.
Pass when recorded accrual matches the recomputed figure.

steps.title: Confirm title is in hand or the state process is started

Start the state title process where the document is not yet held.
Done when title status is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Read the title status against the documents on file.
Pass when the recorded title status matches the documents held.

steps.title: Photograph the asset on intake
sop: Photograph the asset at intake covering all sides and the interior.
Upload the photos to the claim file repository with capture dates.
Done when intake photos are uploaded and dated.
verify: Check the photo capture dates against the receipt date.
Pass when intake photos are dated at or near the receipt date.

steps.title: Record the custody entry on the claim
sop: Save the custody record with facility, dates, rate and title status.
Link the intake photos to the custody record.
Done when the custody record is complete and linked.
verify: Open the custody record and confirm all four elements and photos.
Pass when the record shows facility, receipt date, rate and title status.

steps.title: Diary movement before storage exceeds the recovery threshold
sop: Calculate the date storage cost reaches the recovery threshold.
Set a diary to move the asset before that date.
Done when the storage threshold diary exists.
verify: Check the diary date against the calculated threshold date.
Pass when a diary exists before storage reaches the threshold.

generic.Defined scope/population: Salvage reserve estimates booked on the recovery exposure for this asset.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assets with no comparable sales logged with the alternative basis used.
generic.Test population: Salvage reserves booked on recovery exposures in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a salvage reserve is booked gross of expected commission and storage.
generic.Exception handling path: Assets with volatile markets refer to the salvage coordinator for a conservative basis.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Salvage reserve booked with a documented basis and expected deductions.
generic.Evidence location: Recovery exposure reserve in the claims platform plus the Excel estimating worksheet.

steps.title: Estimate expected proceeds from comparable salvage sales
sop: Pull recent comparable salvage sales for the asset type and damage grade.
Estimate expected gross proceeds from those comparables.
Done when the expected gross figure is estimated.
verify: Check the comparables used are recent and same asset type.
Pass when the estimate rests on recent comparable sales.

steps.title: Adjust for title brand, location and market conditions
sop: Adjust the estimate for title brand, location and theft-recovery status.
Adjust for the current scrap and parts market.
Done when all market adjustments are applied.
verify: Read each adjustment and confirm the basis is stated.
Pass when every adjustment carries a documented basis.

steps.title: Deduct expected commission, tow and storage
sop: Deduct expected vendor commission, tow and storage from the gross estimate.
Record each expected deduction separately.
Done when the expected net figure is derived.
verify: Recompute gross less deductions and compare to the net.
Pass when the net equals gross less each expected deduction.

steps.title: Book the salvage reserve on the recovery exposure
sop: Open the recovery exposure on the claim.
Book the salvage reserve at the expected net amount.
Done when the reserve is booked at the net figure.
verify: Compare the booked reserve to the calculated net figure.
Pass when the booked reserve equals the expected net amount.

steps.title: Record the data source and assumptions
sop: Record the comparable sales source and the extract date.
Record the assumptions used for adjustments and deductions.
Done when source and assumptions are recorded.
verify: Read the note and confirm the source and assumptions appear.
Pass when the reserve note documents source and assumptions.

steps.title: Confirm the reserve is net not gross
sop: Check the booked reserve excludes expected commission and storage.
Correct the reserve where it was booked gross.
Done when the booked reserve is confirmed net.
verify: Compare the booked reserve to the gross estimate.
Pass when no salvage reserve is booked gross of expected deductions.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claim financials on this claim being updated with netted salvage proceeds.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Misposted recoveries logged with the reversal and the corrected posting reference.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any salvage recovery is posted under the subrogation recovery type.
generic.Exception handling path: Recovery type errors are reversed and reposted under the salvage recovery type.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim financial summary reflects netted salvage proceeds against incurred.
generic.Evidence location: Claim financial summary in the claims platform plus the recovery record in the payment system.

steps.title: Apply the netted salvage proceeds to the correct exposure
sop: Identify the exposure the salvage asset relates to.
Apply the netted proceeds to reduce incurred on that exposure.
Done when the proceeds are applied to the correct exposure.
verify: Check the exposure reference on the recovery transaction.
Pass when the recovery sits on the exposure the asset relates to.

steps.title: Confirm the recovery type is salvage
sop: Check the recovery type recorded on the transaction.
Correct any entry posted as subrogation or a payment reversal.
Done when the recovery type reads salvage.
verify: Read the recovery type on the posted transaction.
Pass when no salvage recovery is posted under the subrogation type.

steps.title: Verify the reserve releases to match the reduced incurred
sop: Check the reserve position after the recovery is applied.
Release any reserve no longer needed for the recovered amount.
Done when the reserve matches the reduced incurred position.
verify: Compare the reserve movement to the recovery applied.
Pass when the reserve position is consistent with the reduced incurred.

steps.title: Check the claim financial summary totals
sop: Open the claim financial summary after the update.
Check paid, recovered and incurred totals are consistent.
Done when the summary totals are checked.
verify: Recompute incurred as paid less recovered on the exposure.
Pass when the summary incurred equals paid less recovered.

steps.title: Record the update with the recovery reference
sop: Write the update note citing the recovery ledger reference.
Save the note against the claim financials.
Done when the update note with reference is saved.
verify: Read the note and confirm the ledger reference appears.
Pass when the note ties the update to the ledger posting.

steps.title: Reconcile the claim figure to the recovery ledger entry
sop: Compare the claim recovery figure to the recovery ledger entry.
Raise a correction where the two differ.
Done when claim and ledger figures agree.
verify: Compute the difference between claim and ledger recovery figures.
Pass when there is no difference between the claim and the ledger.

generic.Defined scope/population: Vendor invoices paid in the audit period joined to their contracted fee schedules.

generic.Exception handling path: Overbilling raises a recovery or credit request to the vendor with the audit evidence.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Audit results recorded with the variance count and total exception value.
generic.Evidence location: Excel audit worksheet plus the vendor file and payment ledger in the claims platform.

steps.title: Extract paid vendor invoices for the audit period
sop: Extract paid vendor invoices for the period from the claims platform.
Join them to the contracted fee schedule for each vendor.
Done when the joined data set is built for the period.
verify: Compare extracted invoice count and value to the payment ledger.
Pass when extract and ledger totals agree for the period.

steps.title: Test billed rates against contracted rates
sop: Compare every billed rate to the contracted rate for the service date.
Flag each variance with its dollar impact.
Done when all rate lines are tested and variances flagged.
verify: Recompute a sample of rate variances from the contract rates.
Pass when sampled variances match the flagged values.

steps.title: Test for duplicate invoices and duplicate line items
sop: Test for repeated invoice numbers across the period.
Test for identical line items billed across assignments.
Done when all duplicate tests are complete.
verify: Review flagged duplicates against the original invoices.
Pass when no duplicate invoice number was paid twice.

steps.title: Test for unauthorized lines and out-of-range charges
sop: Compare invoice lines to the authorized scope on each assignment.
Flag charges dated outside the assignment date range.
Done when unauthorized and out-of-range lines are flagged.
verify: Check each flag against the assignment scope and dates.
Pass when every flagged line is outside scope or date range.

steps.title: Quantify total overbilling and raise recovery requests
sop: Total the exception value across rate, duplicate and unauthorized lines.
Raise recovery or credit requests with each affected vendor.
Done when every exception is quantified and a request raised.
verify: Compare recovery requests to the exception value by vendor.
Pass when every exception has a recovery or credit request.

steps.title: Record the audit result on the vendor file
sop: Record the variance count and total exception value on the vendor file.
Feed the invoice accuracy metric into the vendor scorecard.
Done when the audit result is recorded per vendor.
verify: Open the vendor file and confirm the result and metric.
Pass when the vendor file records the variance count and exception value.

generic.Defined scope/population: Network vendors with assignments in the scorecard reporting period.

generic.Exception handling path: Metrics with data quality gaps are marked unrated rather than estimated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Scorecard published per vendor with SLA, cycle time, rework, CSAT and invoice accuracy.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform scorecard plus the Excel scorecard pack for the review meeting.

steps.title: Pull core performance metrics per vendor
sop: Pull assignment volume, SLA attainment and average cycle time per vendor.
Pull rework or reinspection rate and CSAT for the period.
Done when all core metrics are extracted per vendor.
verify: Compare extracted assignment volume to the claims platform count.
Pass when extracted volume matches the system assignment count.

steps.title: Add invoice accuracy and average severity
sop: Add the invoice accuracy result from the audit to each vendor row.
Add average claim severity so cost and quality sit together.
Done when both metrics are added per vendor.
verify: Check the invoice accuracy figure against the audit result.
Pass when the scorecard accuracy matches the audit result.

steps.title: Normalise metrics by assignment volume
sop: Normalise rate-based metrics by assignment volume.
Mark vendors below the minimum volume as unranked.

verify: Check low-volume vendors are marked unranked.
Pass when no low-volume vendor is ranked against high-volume peers.

steps.title: Apply the agreed weightings to produce the score
sop: Apply the agreed metric weightings to each vendor row.
Calculate the overall score and assign the tier.
Done when every vendor has a score and tier.
verify: Recompute a sample of scores from the weightings.
Pass when sampled scores match the published figures.

steps.title: Confirm all metrics come from system data
sop: Trace each metric to its system source rather than vendor reporting.
Mark any metric without a system source as unrated.
Done when every metric is traced to a system source.
verify: Check the source reference recorded for each metric.
Pass when no scored metric relies on vendor-supplied figures.

steps.title: Publish the scorecard pack to claims and procurement
sop: Assemble the scorecard pack for the review meeting.
Publish it to claims management and procurement ahead of the meeting.
Done when the pack is published before the review.
verify: Check the publication date against the review meeting date.
Pass when the pack was published ahead of the review meeting.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scorecard vendors tested against the agreed performance thresholds for the period.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Underperformer list produced with the specific failing metrics per vendor.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform threshold view plus the Excel underperformer list.

steps.title: Apply the performance thresholds to the scorecard
sop: Apply the SLA attainment, rework, CSAT and cycle time thresholds.
Mark every vendor breaching a threshold.
Done when all thresholds are applied to the scorecard.
verify: Recompute a sample of threshold tests from the metric values.
Pass when sampled threshold results match the markings.

steps.title: Exclude vendors below the minimum assignment volume
sop: Apply the minimum assignment volume for statistical relevance.
Exclude vendors below it and record the volume figure.
Done when low-volume vendors are excluded and noted.
verify: Check each flagged vendor volume against the minimum.
Pass when no flagged vendor sits below the minimum volume.

steps.title: Check whether underperformance is concentrated
sop: Split failing metrics by region, loss type and period.
Note where the failure is concentrated rather than systemic.
Done when concentration analysis is complete per flagged vendor.
verify: Read the concentration note for each flagged vendor.
Pass when every flagged vendor has a concentration observation.

steps.title: Confirm existing remediation status before re-flagging
sop: Check whether the vendor already sits under an open remediation plan.
Annotate rather than raise a new flag where remediation is open.
Done when remediation status is confirmed for every flagged vendor.
verify: Compare flags to the open remediation plan register.
Pass when no vendor under open remediation is flagged as new.

steps.title: Assemble the evidence per failing metric
sop: Attach the metric values and periods evidencing each failure.
Reference the scorecard version used.
Done when every failing metric carries its evidence.
verify: Check each failing metric has a value and period recorded.
Pass when no failing metric is listed without evidence.

steps.title: Produce the underperformer list
sop: Compile the list with vendor, failing metrics and evidence.
Route it into the remediation recommendation step.
Done when the underperformer list is produced and routed.
verify: Read the list and confirm each vendor names its failing metrics.
Pass when every listed vendor shows its specific failing metrics.

generic.Defined scope/population: Preferred vendor fee schedules reaching renewal in the negotiation cycle.
generic.In-scope period: From the renewal window opening to the executed renewal being loaded with an effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Volume, spend, performance data, proposed rates, SLA terms and renewal effective date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Volume and spend used in negotiation reconcile to the claims platform payment data.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rates agreed above benchmark logged with the justification and the approver.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Executed renewal recorded with the rate schedule, SLA terms and effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository plus the Excel negotiation analysis pack.

steps.title: Assemble volume, spend and performance data
sop: Extract vendor assignment volume, spend and performance for the term.
Build the negotiation pack from that data.
Done when the negotiation pack is assembled.
verify: Compare pack volume and spend to the claims platform figures.
Pass when the pack figures reconcile to system data.

steps.title: Benchmark proposed rates against market and peers
sop: Benchmark the proposed rates against market rates for the service.
Compare against peer vendors inside the network.
Done when benchmarking is complete for every rate line.
verify: Check each rate line carries a benchmark comparison.
Pass when every proposed rate has a benchmark reference.

steps.title: Agree the rate schedule, SLA and volume mechanism
sop: Agree the rate schedule and the SLA commitments per stage.
Agree any volume tier or rebate mechanism.
Done when rates, SLA and volume terms are agreed.
verify: Read the agreed terms and confirm all three areas are covered.
Pass when the agreement covers rates, SLA and volume terms.

steps.title: Confirm audit, insurance and termination provisions carry over
sop: Check audit rights, insurance requirements and termination provisions.
Confirm they carry into the renewal unchanged or improved.
Done when all three provisions are confirmed in the renewal.
verify: Compare the renewal provisions to the expiring contract.
Pass when audit, insurance and termination provisions are retained.

steps.title: Execute the renewal and load the new rate file
sop: Execute the renewal in the contract lifecycle management repository.
Load the new rate file with its effective date.
Done when the renewal is executed and the rate file loaded.
verify: Check the loaded rate file effective date against the renewal.
Pass when the loaded rate file matches the executed renewal.

steps.title: Archive the superseded schedule and check for expiries
sop: Archive the superseded rate file with its end date.
Check no vendor receiving assignments holds an expired schedule.
Done when the old file is archived and expiries are checked.
verify: List active vendors and check their schedule expiry dates.
Pass when no active vendor holds an expired fee schedule.

generic.Defined scope/population: Vendors on the underperformer list being recommended for remediation, tier change or removal.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Remediation or removal recommendation documented with failing metrics and the decision.
generic.Evidence location: Vendor record in the claims platform plus the contract lifecycle management repository.

steps.title: State the failing metrics and the period covered
sop: List each failing metric and the period it covers for the vendor.
Attach the scorecard evidence to the recommendation.
Done when metrics and period are stated for every vendor.
verify: Check each recommendation names metrics and a period.
Pass when every recommendation states the failing metrics and period.

steps.title: Recommend the action for each vendor
sop: Recommend remediation, volume throttle, tier downgrade or removal.
Record the reasoning behind the chosen action.
Done when every vendor has a recommended action with reasoning.
verify: Read each action and confirm the reasoning is recorded.
Pass when every recommended action carries reasoning.

steps.title: Define target metrics and the improvement window for remediation
sop: Define the target metric values the vendor must reach.
Set the improvement window and the review date.
Done when targets, window and review date are defined.
verify: Check the remediation plan has targets and a review date.
Pass when every remediation plan states targets and a review date.

steps.title: Plan reassignment of open assignments for removals
sop: List open assignments held by any vendor recommended for removal.
Plan reassignment so no claim is stranded.
Done when every open assignment has a reassignment plan.
verify: Compare open assignments to the reassignment plan entries.
Pass when no open assignment lacks a reassignment plan.

steps.title: Take the recommendation to governance
sop: Present the recommendations to the vendor governance forum.
Capture the decision made for each vendor.
Done when a decision is recorded for every recommendation.
verify: Check each recommendation carries a governance decision.
Pass when every recommendation has a recorded decision.

steps.title: Record the recommendation and decision on the vendor record
sop: Record the recommendation and the governance decision on the vendor record.
Update the vendor status where the decision changes it.
Done when the record reflects the recommendation and decision.
verify: Open the vendor record and confirm recommendation, decision and status.
Pass when the vendor record shows the recommendation and decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Customer satisfaction responses on claims where a repair or mitigation vendor attended.

generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform survey dashboard plus the claim records in the claims platform.

steps.title: Pull survey results for vendor-attended claims
sop: Extract CSAT and net promoter results for the reporting period.
Filter to claims where a repair or mitigation vendor attended.
Done when the filtered survey set is extracted.
verify: Compare the response count to vendor-attended claims in the period.
Pass when responses tie to vendor-attended claims.

steps.title: Split scores by vendor and service type
sop: Split the results by vendor and by service type.
Keep repair and mitigation results separate rather than blended.

verify: Check no vendor row blends repair and mitigation service types.
Pass when repair and mitigation results are reported separately.

steps.title: Read detractor verbatims and tag the driver
sop: Read the detractor verbatim comments for each vendor.
Tag the driver as delay, communication, workmanship, cleanliness or rework.
Done when every detractor verbatim carries a driver tag.
verify: Count tagged verbatims against the detractor response count.
Pass when every detractor response carries a driver tag.

steps.title: Compare each vendor to the network average and CSAT floor
sop: Calculate the network average score for the period.
Compare each vendor to the average and the contract CSAT floor.
Done when every vendor is compared to both benchmarks.
verify: Check each vendor row shows both comparisons.
Pass when every vendor is compared to the average and the floor.

steps.title: Flag vendors below the reporting minimum response count
sop: Apply the minimum response count for reportable conclusions.
Flag vendors below it as indicative only.
Done when low-response vendors are flagged.
verify: Check flagged vendors against their response counts.
Pass when no conclusion is drawn below the reporting minimum.

steps.title: Feed vendor drivers into the scorecard and review pack
sop: Record the findings and vendor-specific drivers.
Feed them into the scorecard and the vendor review pack.
Done when findings and drivers are recorded and fed forward.
verify: Check the scorecard reflects the recorded CSAT drivers.
Pass when the scorecard carries the vendor-level CSAT drivers.

generic.Defined scope/population: Network vendors holding assignments in the closed quarter being scored.

steps.title: Freeze the quarter data set

Done when the quarter data set is frozen.
verify: Compare frozen counts to the claims platform for the quarter.

steps.title: Calculate cycle times per vendor for the quarter
sop: Calculate acknowledgement, first-contact and completion cycle times.
Average them per vendor for the quarter.

Pass when sampled cycle times match the reported figures.

steps.title: Calculate rework rate and supplement frequency
sop: Calculate the rework or reinspection rate per vendor.
Calculate supplement frequency as a quality indicator.

verify: Recompute a sample of rework rates from the underlying data.

steps.title: Compute SLA attainment per stage

Compare each to the contracted commitment.
Done when attainment is computed and compared per stage.
verify: Check each attainment figure against the contracted commitment.
Pass when every stage attainment is compared to its commitment.

steps.title: Record the quarterly scores on the vendor record
sop: Record the quarterly SLA, cycle time and rework scores per vendor.
Note quarter-on-quarter movement for each metric.
Done when scores and movement are recorded.
verify: Open the vendor record and confirm scores and prior-quarter comparison.
Pass when the record shows the scores with prior-quarter movement.

steps.title: Confirm every active vendor is scored
sop: List vendors holding active assignments in the quarter.
Score any vendor left unscored before closing the cycle.
Done when every active vendor has a quarterly score.
verify: Compare scored vendors to vendors with active assignments.
Pass when no active vendor is left unscored for the quarter.

generic.Defined scope/population: Vendor directory entries and routing rules in the claims system being updated this cycle.

steps.title: Update vendor status and tier in the directory

steps.title: Update service areas and approved service types

steps.title: Update the routing rules to the revised order
sop: Update the routing rules so assignments follow the revised tier order.

steps.title: Record the change reason, approver and effective date

Set the effective date for the change.
Done when reason, approver and effective date are recorded.
verify: Open the directory version and confirm all three fields.
Pass when the version records reason, approver and effective date.

steps.title: Run a test assignment routing for an affected geography
sop: Run a test routing for an affected ZIP or state.
Confirm the correct vendor is returned in the expected order.
Done when the test routing returns the expected vendor.
verify: Compare the returned vendor to the intended routing order.
Pass when the test returns the vendor the rules intend.

steps.title: Confirm removed and on-hold vendors are unreachable
sop: Test routing for geographies served by removed or on-hold vendors.
Confirm none of them is returned by an active rule.
Done when removed and on-hold vendors are unreachable.
verify: Check test results for any removed or on-hold vendor.

generic.Defined scope/population: Credentials, licences, insurance and trade certifications for network member vendors.
generic.In-scope period: The verification cycle from the credential review start to reminders being set.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Licence number, issuing authority, insurance limits, certificate holder and expiry dates.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Credential records on file equal the credentials required for each vendor service type.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Licence verification, certificate of insurance and certifications retained with expiry dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lapsed or missing credentials logged with the vendor set to Hold until resolved.
generic.Test population: Network member vendors due credential verification in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a vendor is left Active with an expired licence or insurance certificate.
generic.Exception handling path: Any lapsed credential sets the vendor to Hold and pauses new assignments.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current licence, insurance certificate and trade certifications on file with expiry dates.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository plus the claim file document repository.

steps.title: Verify the licence number with the issuing authority
sop: Check the contractor or shop licence number with the issuing state authority.
Record the verification date and the result.
Done when the licence is verified and the date recorded.
verify: Compare the verified licence status to the vendor record.
Pass when the licence is confirmed current with the authority.

steps.title: Obtain the certificate of insurance and check limits
sop: Obtain the current certificate of insurance from the vendor.
Check general liability, auto and workers compensation limits meet the contract minimums.
Done when all three limits are checked against the contract.
verify: Compare each limit to the contract minimum requirement.
Pass when every insurance limit meets the contract minimum.

steps.title: Confirm the certificate holder and policy currency
sop: Check the company is named correctly as certificate holder.
Confirm the policy is in force at the verification date.
Done when holder and policy currency are confirmed.
verify: Read the certificate holder name and policy dates.
Pass when the holder is correct and the policy is in force.

steps.title: Check trade certifications for the service type
sop: Identify the certifications required for the vendor service types.
Confirm each required certification is current.
Done when every required certification is checked.
verify: Compare held certifications to those required for the service type.
Pass when every required certification is current.

steps.title: Record expiry dates and set renewal reminders
sop: Record every credential expiry date on the vendor record.
Set advance renewal reminders before each expiry.
Done when expiry dates and reminders are set.
verify: Check each credential has an expiry date and a reminder.
Pass when no credential lacks an expiry date and reminder.

steps.title: Set the vendor to Hold where a credential has lapsed
sop: Identify vendors with any lapsed credential.
Set them to Hold so no new assignments route to them.
Done when every vendor with a lapse is set to Hold.
verify: Cross-check Active vendors against credential expiry dates.
Pass when no Active vendor holds an expired licence or insurance certificate.
